def solve():
    findings = 32
    tier1_count = 27
    tier1_cost = Q(650)
    tier2_cost = Q(1900)
    early_closed = 4
    credit_per = Q(175)
    cap_ratio = Q(20) / 100
    threshold = Q(30000)

    # Gross tiered cost before any credit
    n1 = min(findings, tier1_count)
    n2 = max(findings - tier1_count, 0)
    gross = n1 * tier1_cost + n2 * tier2_cost

    # Uncapped early-closure credit
    uncapped = early_closed * credit_per

    # Applied credit: capped at 20% of gross, only if gross >= threshold
    if gross >= threshold:
        applied = min(uncapped, cap_ratio * gross)
    else:
        applied = Q(0)

    # Net remediation cost
    net = gross - applied
    return {
        "final": net,
        "gross_cost": gross,
        "uncapped_credit": uncapped,
        "applied_credit": applied,
    }
